120: newTalent{
121: 	name = "Retribution",
122: 	type = {"celestial/guardian", 3},
123: 	require = divi_req_high3, no_sustain_autoreset = true,
124: 	points = 5,
125: 	mode = "sustained",
126: 	sustain_positive = 20,
127: 	cooldown = 10,
128: 	range = function(self, t) return math.floor(self:combatTalentScale(t, 2, 6)) end,
129: 	tactical = { DEFEND = 2 },
130: 	getDamage = function(self, t) return self:combatTalentSpellDamage(t, 40, 400) end,
131: 	iconOverlay = function(self, t, p)
132: 		local val = self.retribution_absorb or 0
133: 		if val <= 0 then return "" end
134: 		local fnt = "buff_font_small"
135: 		if val >= 1000 then fnt = "buff_font_smaller" end
136: 		return "#RED#"..tostring(math.ceil(val)).."#LAST#", fnt
137: 	end,
138: 	activate = function(self, t)
139: 		local shield = self:hasShield()
140: 		if not shield then
141: 			game.logPlayer(self, "You cannot use Retribution without a shield!")
142: 			return nil
143: 		end
144: 		local power = t.getDamage(self, t)
145: 		self.retribution_absorb = power
146: 		self.retribution_strike = power
147: 		game:playSoundNear(self, "talents/generic")
148: 		return {
149: 			shield = self:addTemporaryValue("retribution", power),
150: 		}
151: 	end,
152: 	deactivate = function(self, t, p)
153: 		self:removeTemporaryValue("retribution", p.shield)
154: 		self.retribution_absorb = nil
155: 		self.retribution_strike = nil
156: 		return true
157: 	end,
158: 	callbackOnRest = function(self, t)  -- Make sure we've actually started resting/running before disabling the sustain
159: 		if self.resting.cnt and self.resting.cnt <= 0 then return end
160: 		self.retribution_absorb = self.retribution		
161: 	end,
162: 	callbackOnRun = function(self, t)
163: 		if self.running.cnt and self.running.cnt <= 0 then return end
164: 		self.retribution_absorb = self.retribution		
165: 	end,
166: 	info = function(self, t)
167: 		local damage = t.getDamage(self, t)
168: 		local absorb_string = ""
169: 		if self.retribution_absorb and self.retribution_strike then
170: 			absorb_string = ([[#RED#Absorb Remaining: %d]]):tformat(self.retribution_absorb)
171: 		end
172: 
173: 		return ([[Retribution negates half of all damage you take while it is active. Once Retribution has negated %0.2f damage, your shield will explode in a burst of light, inflicting damage equal to the amount negated in a radius of %d and deactivating the talent.
174: 		The amount absorbed will increase with your Spellpower.
175: 		%s]]):
176: 		tformat(damage, self:getTalentRange(t), absorb_string)
177: 	end,
178: }
179: 
180: -- Moderate damage but very short CD
181: -- Spamming this on cooldown keeps positive energy up and gives a lot of cooldown management

20: newTalent{

22: 	type = {"undead/lich", 1},
23: 	mode = "passive",

25: 	points = 5,

36: 			_G.a=dialog

39: 			dialog:restoreResources(self)

42: 			game.level.map:particleEmitter(self.x, self.y, 1, "demon_teleport")

58: 				game:saveGame()
59: 			end, force_choice=true}

62: 	info = function(self, t)

193: newTalent{
194: 	name = "Aether Avatar",
195: 	type = {"spell/aether", 3},
196: 	require = spells_req_high3,
197: 	points = 5,
198: 	mana = 60,
199: 	cooldown = function(self, t)
200: 		local rcd = math.ceil(self:combatTalentLimit(t, 15, 37, 25)) -- Limit > 15
201: 		return self:attr("arcane_cooldown_divide") and rcd * self.arcane_cooldown_divide or rcd 
202: 	end,
203: 	range = 10,
204: 	direct_hit = true,
205: 	use_only_arcane = 1,
206: 	requires_target = true,
207: 	no_energy = true,
208: 	tactical = { BUFF = 2 },
209: 	getNb = function(self, t) return math.floor(self:combatTalentLimit(t, 15, 5.1, 10.1)) end, -- Limit duration < 15	
210: 	callbackOnTalentPost = function(self, t, ab)
211: 		if not self:hasEffect(self.EFF_AETHER_AVATAR) then return end
212: 		if ab.mode == "sustained" then return end
213: 		if not ab.is_spell then return end
214: 		if ab.use_only_arcane and self:getTalentLevel(t) >= ab.use_only_arcane then return end
215: 		if self:attr("force_talent_ignore_ressources") then return end
216: 		if self.turn_procs.aether_avatar_penalty then return end
217: 		self:incMana(-50)
218: 		game.logSeen(self, "#VIOLET#%s loses 50 mana from using a non-Arcane talent!#LAST#", self:getName():capitalize())
219: 
220: 		self.turn_procs.aether_avatar_penalty = true
221: 	end,
222: 	getSpellsList = function(self, t)
223: 		local levels = {}
224: 		local tids = {}
225: 		local function check(tid)
226: 			if tids[tid] then return end
227: 			tids[tid] = true
228: 			local tt = self:getTalentFromId(tid)
229: 			if tt.use_only_arcane then
230: 				levels[tt.use_only_arcane] = levels[tt.use_only_arcane] or {}
231: 				table.insert(levels[tt.use_only_arcane], tt.name)
232: 			end
233: 		end
234: 
235: 		for tid, _ in pairs(self.talents) do check(tid) end
236: 		for tree, _ in pairs(self.talents_types) do
237: 			for _, checkt in ipairs(self.talents_types_def[tree] and self.talents_types_def[tree].talents or {}) do check(checkt.id) end
238: 		end
239: 
240: 		local list = {}
241: 		for i = 1, 10 do if levels[i] then
242: 			table.sort(levels[i])
243: 			list[#list+1] = ("At level %d: #AQUAMARINE#%s#LAST#"):tformat(i, table.concatNice(levels[i], '#LAST#, #AQUAMARINE#', _t'#LAST# and #AQUAMARINE#'))
244: 		end end
245: 		return table.concat(list, "\n")
246: 	end,
247: 	action = function(self, t)
248: 		local aegis
249: 		self:setEffect(self.EFF_AETHER_AVATAR, t.getNb(self, t), {})
250: 		if self:isTalentActive(self.T_PURE_AETHER) and self:getTalentLevel(self.T_PURE_AETHER) >= 5 then
251: 			self:removeEffectsFilter(self, function(eff) return eff.status == "detrimental" and (eff.type == "physical" or eff.type == "magical") end, self:callTalent(self.T_PURE_AETHER, "getNbRemove"))
252: 		end
253: 		game:playSoundNear(self, "talents/arcane")
254: 		return true
255: 	end,
256: 	info = function(self, t)
257: 		return ([[Infuse your body with untethered aether forces for %d turns.
258: 		While active, the cooldown for Arcane and Aether spells is divided by 3, your arcane damage and penetration is increased by 25%%, your Disruption Shield radius is increased to 10, and your maximum mana is increased by 33%%.
259: 		Using non arcane based spells in this state is hard and makes you lose 50 mana each time (up to once per turn).
260: 		
261: 		Spells considered arcane for the purpose of not-losing mana are:
262: 		%s]]):
263: 		tformat(t.getNb(self, t), t.getSpellsList(self, t))
264: 	end,
265: }

69: newTalent{
70: 	name = "Exoskeleton",

87: 		local val = (self.exoskeleton_absorb or 0)

92: 	end,
93: 	callbackOnTalentPost = function(self, t, ab, ret)

103:

106: 
107: 		self.using_steam_exoskeleton = true
108: 		self:updateModdableTile()
109: 
110: 		return ret
111: 	end,

115: 
116: 		self.exoskeleton_absorb = nil

123: 			local exoReduction = damageReduction
124: 			self.exoskeleton_absorb = math.max(0, self.exoskeleton_absorb - exoReduction )
125: 			game:delayedLogDamage(src or self, self, 0, ("#STEEL_BLUE#(%d exoskeleton)#LAST#"):tformat(damageReduction), nil)
126: 		end
127: 		return cb.value
128: 	end,
129: 	callbackOnActBase = function(self,t)
130: 		if self:isTalentActive(self.T_EXOSKELETON) then
131: 
132: 			local maxDamage = t.getMaxDamage(self, t)
133: 
134: 			if (self.exoskeleton_absorb or 0) > maxDamage then
135: 				self.exoskeleton_absorb = maxDamage
136: 			end
137: 			if (self.exoskeleton_absorb or 0) < maxDamage then
138: 				self.exoskeleton_absorb = math.min((self.exoskeleton_absorb or 0) + (maxDamage * 0.05), maxDamage)
139: 			end
140: 		end
141: 	end,
142: 	info = function(self, t)
143: 		return ([[Current exoskeleton life: %d/%d
144: 		You craft a set of steam powered armor that fits over your regular armor, enhancing your defense. The armor has %d life, and 50%% of all damage taken is redirected to it.
145: 		Your powered armour repairs 5%% of it’s maximum life each turn, and each time you spend steam it will be repaired for %d%% of the steam cost.
146: 		The armor's maximum life will increase with your Steampower.]]):tformat((self.exoskeleton_absorb or 0),t.getMaxDamage(self,t),t.getMaxDamage(self,t), t.getSteamHeal(self,t))
147: 	end,
148: }

523: 		else

545: newInscription{
546: 	name = "Rune of the Rift",
547: 	type = {"inscriptions/runes", 1},
548: 	points = 1,
549: 	is_spell = true,
550: 	tactical = { DISABLE = 2, ATTACK = { TEMPORAL = 1 } },
551: 	direct_hit = true,
552: 	reflectable = true,
553: 	requires_target = true,
554: 	range = 6,
555: 	target = function(self, t)
556: 		return {type="hit", range=self:getTalentRange(t), talent=t}
557: 	end,
558: 	getDamage = function(self, t) return 150 + self:getWil() * 4 end,
559: 	getDuration = function(self, t) return 4 end,
560: 	action = function(self, t)
561: 		local tg = self:getTalentTarget(t)
562: 		local x, y = self:getTarget(tg)
563: 		if not x or not y then return nil end
564: 		local _ _, x, y = self:canProject(tg, x, y)
565: 		local target = game.level.map(x, y, Map.ACTOR)
566: 		if not target then return end
567: 
568: 		if target:attr("timetravel_immune") then
569: 			game.logSeen(target, "%s is immune!", target:getName():capitalize())
570: 			return true
571: 		end
572: 
573: 		local hit = self:checkHit(self:combatSpellpower(), target:combatSpellResist() + (target:attr("continuum_destabilization") or 0))
574: 		if not hit then game.logSeen(target, "%s resists!", target:getName():capitalize()) return true end
575: 
576: 		self:project(tg, x, y, DamageType.TEMPORAL, self:spellCrit(t.getDamage(self, t)))
577: 		game.level.map:particleEmitter(x, y, 1, "temporal_thrust")
578: 		game:playSoundNear(self, "talents/arcane")
579: 		self:incParadox(-25)
580: 		if target.dead or target.player then return true end
581: 		target:setEffect(target.EFF_CONTINUUM_DESTABILIZATION, 100, {power=self:combatSpellpower(0.3)})
582: 		
583: 	-- Placeholder for the actor
584: 		local oe = game.level.map(x, y, Map.TERRAIN+1)
585: 		if (oe and oe:attr("temporary")) or game.level.map:checkEntity(x, y, Map.TERRAIN, "block_move") then game.logPlayer(self, "Something has prevented the timetravel.") return true end
586: 		local e = mod.class.Object.new{
587: 			old_feat = oe, type = "temporal", subtype = "instability",
588: 			name = _t"temporal instability",
589: 			display = '&', color=colors.LIGHT_BLUE,
590: 			temporary = t.getDuration(self, t),
591: 			canAct = false,
592: 			target = target,
593: 			act = function(self)
594: 				self:useEnergy()
595: 				self.temporary = self.temporary - 1
596: 				-- return the rifted actor
597: 				if self.temporary <= 0 then
598: 					-- remove ourselves
599: 					if self.old_feat then game.level.map(self.target.x, self.target.y, engine.Map.TERRAIN+1, self.old_feat)
600: 					else game.level.map:remove(self.target.x, self.target.y, engine.Map.TERRAIN+1) end
601: 					game.nicer_tiles:updateAround(game.level, self.target.x, self.target.y)
602: 					game.level:removeEntity(self)
603: 					game.level.map:removeParticleEmitter(self.particles)
604: 					
605: 					-- return the actor and reset their values
606: 					local mx, my = util.findFreeGrid(self.target.x, self.target.y, 20, true, {[engine.Map.ACTOR]=true})
607: 					local old_levelup = self.target.forceLevelup
608: 					local old_check = self.target.check
609: 					self.target.forceLevelup = function() end
610: 					self.target.check = function() end
611: 					game.zone:addEntity(game.level, self.target, "actor", mx, my)
612: 					self.target.forceLevelup = old_levelup
613: 					self.target.check = old_check
614: 				end
615: 			end,
616: 			summoner_gain_exp = true, summoner = self,
617: 		}
618: 		
619: 		-- Remove the target
620: 		game.logSeen(target, "%s has moved forward in time!", target:getName():capitalize())
621: 		game.level:removeEntity(target, true)
622: 		
623: 		-- add the time skip object to the map
624: 		local particle = Particles.new("wormhole", 1, {image="shockbolt/terrain/temporal_instability_yellow", speed=1})
625: 		particle.zdepth = 6
626: 		e.particles = game.level.map:addParticleEmitter(particle, x, y)
627: 		game.level:addEntity(e)
628: 		game.level.map(x, y, Map.TERRAIN+1, e)
629: 		game.level.map:updateMap(x, y)
630: 		return true
631: 	end,
632: 	info = function(self, t)
633: 		local damage = t.getDamage(self, t)
634: 		local duration = t.getDuration(self, t)
635: 		return ([[Inflicts %0.2f temporal damage.  If your target survives, it will be sent %d turns into the future.
636: 		It will also lower your paradox by 25 (if you have any).
637: 		Note that messing with the spacetime continuum may have unforeseen consequences.]]):tformat(damDesc(self, DamageType.TEMPORAL, damage), duration)
638: 	end,
639: 	short_info = function(self, t)
640: 		return ("%0.2f temporal damage, removed from time %d turns"):tformat(t.getDamage(self, t), t.getDuration(self, t))
641: 	end,
642: }

118: local function makeSunGlyph()
119: 	local sun_glyph = Trap.new{
120: 		name = _t"glyph of sunlight",
121: 		is_glyph = "sunlight",
122: 		type = "elemental", id_by_type=true, unided_name = _t"trap",
123: 		display = '^', color=colors.GOLD, image = "trap/trap_glyph_explosion_02_64.png",
124: 		disarmable = false,
125: 		no_disarm_message = true,
126: 		message = false,
127: 		all_know = true,
128: 		always_remember = true,
129: 		faction = self.faction,
130: 		dam = dam,
131: 		heal = heal,
132: 		desc = function(self)
133: 			return ([[Deals %d light damage and heals the summoner for %d]]):tformat(engine.interface.ActorTalents.damDesc(self, engine.DamageType.LIGHT, self.dam), self.heal)
134: 		end,
135: 		canTrigger = function(self, x, y, who)
136: 			if who:reactionToward(self.summoner) < 0 then return mod.class.Trap.canTrigger(self, x, y, who) end
137: 			return false
138: 		end,
139: 		triggered = function(self, x, y, who)
140: 			if self.dam then
141: 				self.summoner:project({type="hit", x=x,y=y}, x, y, engine.DamageType.LIGHT, self.dam, {type="light"})
142: 			end
143: 			game.level.map:particleEmitter(x, y, 0, "sunburst", {radius=0, x=x, y=y})
144: 			self.summoner:heal(self.heal, self)
145: 	--divine glyphs buff
146: 			if self.summoner:knowTalent(self.summoner.T_DIVINE_GLYPHS) then
147: 				self.summoner.turn_procs.divine_glyphs = self.summoner.turn_procs.divine_glyphs or 0
148: 				if self.summoner.turn_procs.divine_glyphs < 3 then
149: 					local dg = self.summoner:getTalentFromId(self.summoner.T_DIVINE_GLYPHS)
150: 					local maxStacks = dg.getMaxStacks(self.summoner, dg)
151: 					local dur = dg.getTurns(self.summoner, dg)
152: 					self.summoner:setEffect(self.summoner.EFF_DIVINE_GLYPHS, dur, {maxStacks=maxStacks})
153: 					self.summoner.turn_procs.divine_glyphs = self.summoner.turn_procs.divine_glyphs + 1
154: 				end
155: 			end
156: 			return true, true
157: 		end,
158: 		temporary = t.getDuration(self, t),
159: 		x = tx, y = ty,
160: 		inc_damage = table.clone(self.inc_damage or {}, true),
161: 		resists_pen = table.clone(self.resists_pen or {}, true),
162: 		canAct = false,
163: 		energy = {value=0},
164: 		act = function(self)
165: 			self:useEnergy()
166: 			self.temporary = self.temporary - 1
167: 			if self.temporary <= 0 then
168: 				if game.level.map(self.x, self.y, engine.Map.TRAP) == self then game.level.map:remove(self.x, self.y, engine.Map.TRAP) end
169: 				game.level:removeEntity(self)
170: 			end
171: 		end,
172: 		summoner = self,
173: 		summoner_gain_exp = true,
174: 	}
175: 	return sun_glyph
176: end

25: 	random_ego = "attack",
26: 	cooldown = 5,
27: 	hate = 5,
28: 	tactical = { ATTACK = { PHYSICAL = 2 } },
29: 	direct_hit = true,
30: 	requires_target = true,
31: 	range = 3,
32: 	getDamage = function(self, t)
33: 		return self:combatTalentMindDamage(t, 0, 280)
34: 	end,
35: 	getKnockback = function(self, t)
36: 		return 2
37: 	end,
38: 		-- damage: initial physical damage and used for fractional knockback damage
39: 	-- knockback: distance to knockback
40: 	-- knockbackDamage: when knockback strikes something, both parties take damage - percent of damage * remaining knockback
41: 	-- power: used to determine the initial radius of particles
42: 	forceHit = function(self, t, target, sourceX, sourceY, damage, knockback, knockbackDamage, power, max)
43: 
44: 		-- give direct hit a direction?
45: 		if sourceX == target.x and sourceY == target.y then
46: 			local newDirection = rng.table(util.adjacentDirs())
47: 			local dx, dy = util.dirToCoord(newDirection, sourceX, sourceY)
48: 			sourceX = sourceX + dx
49: 			sourceY = sourceY + dy
50: 		end
51: 
52: 		-- apply initial damage
53: 		if damage > 0 then
54: 			damage = self:mindCrit(damage)
55: 			self:project({type="hit", range=10, talent=t, pass_terrain=true}, target.x, target.y, DamageType.PHYSICAL, damage)
56: 			game.level.map:particleEmitter(target.x, target.y, 1, "force_hit", {power=power, dx=target.x - sourceX, dy=target.y - sourceY})
57: 		end
58: 
59: 		-- knockback?
60: 		if not target.dead and knockback and knockback > 0 and target:canBe("knockback") and (target.never_move or 0) < 1 then
61: 			local block_actor = function(_, bx, by) return game.level.map:checkEntity(bx, by, Map.TERRAIN, "block_move", target) end
62: 			local lineFunction = core.fov.line(sourceX, sourceY, target.x, target.y, block_actor, true)
63: 			local finalX, finalY = target.x, target.y
64: 			local knockbackCount = 0
65: 			local blocked = false
66: 			while knockback > 0 do
67: 				local x, y, is_corner_blocked = lineFunction:step(true)
68: 
69: 				if not game.level.map:isBound(x, y) or is_corner_blocked or game.level.map:checkAllEntities(x, y, "block_move", target) then
70: 					-- blocked
71: 					local nextTarget = game.level.map(x, y, Map.ACTOR)
72: 					if nextTarget then
73: 						if knockbackCount > 0 then
74: 							target:logCombat(nextTarget, "#Source# was blasted %d spaces into #Target#!", knockbackCount)
75: 						else
76: 							target:logCombat(nextTarget, "#Source# was blasted into #Target#!")
77: 						end
78: 					elseif knockbackCount > 0 then
79: 						game.logSeen(target, "%s was smashed back %d spaces!", target:getName():capitalize(), knockbackCount)
80: 					else
81: 						game.logSeen(target, "%s was smashed!", target:getName():capitalize())
82: 					end
83: 
84: 					-- take partial damage
85: 					local blockDamage = damage * util.bound(knockback * (knockbackDamage / 100), 0, 1.5)
86: 					self:project({type="hit", range=10, talent=t}, target.x, target.y, DamageType.PHYSICAL, blockDamage)
87: 
88: 					if nextTarget then
89: 						-- start a new force hit with the knockback damage and current knockback
90: 						if max > 0 then
91: 							t.forceHit(self, t, nextTarget, sourceX, sourceY, blockDamage, knockback, knockbackDamage, power / 2, max - 1)
92: 						end
93: 					end
94: 
95: 					knockback = 0
96: 					blocked = true
97: 				else
98: 					-- allow move
99: 					finalX, finalY = x, y
100: 					knockback = knockback - 1
101: 					knockbackCount = knockbackCount + 1
102: 				end
103: 			end
104: 
105: 			if not blocked and knockbackCount > 0 then
106: 				game.logSeen(target, "%s was blasted back %d spaces!", target:getName():capitalize(), knockbackCount)
107: 			end
108: 
109: 			if not target.dead and (finalX ~= target.x or finalY ~= target.y) then
110: 				local ox, oy = target.x, target.y
111: 				target:move(finalX, finalY, true)
112: 				if config.settings.tome.smooth_move > 0 then
113: 					target:resetMoveAnim()
114: 					target:setMoveAnim(ox, oy, 9, 5)
115: 				end
116: 			end
117: 		end
118: 	end,
119: 	critpower = function(self, t) return self:combatTalentScale(t, 4, 15) end,
120: 	action = function(self, t)
121: 		local range = self:getTalentRange(t)
122: 
123: 		local tg = {type="hit", range=self:getTalentRange(t), t=t}
124: 		local x, y, target = self:getTarget(tg)
125: 		if not self:canProject(tg, x, y) or not target then return nil end

127: 		--local distance = math.max(1, core.fov.distance(self.x, self.y, x, y))

129: 		local damage = t.getDamage(self, t) * power

131: 		t.forceHit(self, t, target, self.x, self.y, damage, knockback, 7, power, 10)

172: 	getNegPart = function(self, t)

34: 		local value = 10

36: 		if self:knowTalent(self.T_SPACETIME_STABILITY) then
37: 			value = value + (self:callTalent(self.T_SPACETIME_STABILITY, "getTuning") * 2)

43: 			local paradox = self:getParadox()
44: 			if (paradox < self.preferred_paradox or paradox ~= self:getMinParadox()) then
45: 				local power = t.getTuning(self, t)
46: 				if math.abs(paradox - self.preferred_paradox) > 1 then
47: 					local duration = (self.preferred_paradox - paradox)/power
48: 					if duration < 0 then duration, power = -duration, -power end

50: 					self:setEffect(self.EFF_SPACETIME_TUNING, duration, {power=power})
